error.account_not_found: There is no Mullvad account with that number.
error.auth_cancelled: The password prompt was cancelled, so nothing was changed.
error.auth_failed: Mullvad rejected this device. Check your account.
error.busy: Another Mullvad action is still running. Try again in a moment.
error.firewall: Mullvad could not set its firewall policy. Restarting the service may help.
error.invalid_account: A Mullvad account number has 16 digits.
error.invalid_voucher: That voucher code is not valid.
error.ipv6_unavailable: IPv6 is turned off on this system, so the tunnel cannot start.
error.kernel_updated: Your kernel was updated. Reboot so Mullvad can set its firewall.
error.lockdown_blocking: Lockdown mode is blocking traffic while you are disconnected.
error.logged_out: You are logged out of Mullvad.
error.no_polkit_agent: No password prompt is available, so Mullvad couldn't be changed. Turn on Noctalia's polkit agent, or run the command in a terminal.
error.no_relays: The Mullvad server list is not loaded yet.
error.set_dns: Mullvad could not set the system DNS server.
error.start_tunnel: Mullvad could not start the tunnel.
error.timeout: Mullvad did not answer in time.
error.too_many_devices: This account already has the most devices it can have. Revoke one first (on mullvad.net or another device).
error.tunnel_parameter: Mullvad could not pick a matching server. Check your relay settings.
error.unknown: Mullvad is blocking traffic after an error ({reason}).
error.unknown_device: That device is not on this account, or it is the device you are using.
error.unknown_location: That country or city has no Mullvad servers.
error.unknown_no_reason: Mullvad is blocking traffic after an error.
error.used_voucher: That voucher code has already been used.
